post.description:
Register a fish on a dish; idempotent on a client-supplied ``fish_id``.

Subject identity v4 (agent-contracts citrus-palette): a client may
mint the ``fish_id`` (lowercase canonical UUID v4). An existing
``fish_id`` is answered 200 (same creation values; current record) or
409 ``fish_id_conflict`` before any dish check, so an outbox replay
succeeds even after the dish is retired. For a new ``fish_id``: 404
``dish_not_found``, 409 ``dish_inactive``, else 201. Sex, genotype and
species default from the dish when not supplied.

200.description: fish_id already exists with the same creation values; the current record

409.description: fish_id_conflict (existing fish_id, different creation values) or dish_inactive (only for a new fish_id)

422.description: invalid_fish_id or invalid_subject_label; a malformed body gets FastAPI's validation shape instead

get.description: Fetch a single fish subject by UUID.

post.description:
Record that a fish died (docs/fish_deaths_design.md).

Body: ``reason`` (found_dead | euthanized | other), optional ``at``
(RFC 3339 UTC, default now) and ``notes``. Frees its well and lowers
its dish's count by one. 409 ``fish_already_ended`` if it already ended
differently; an identical repeat is 200.

get.description:
Every stored revision of a fish, oldest first.

``kind`` is ``created`` for revision 1, ``changed`` for later edits,
and ``backfilled`` for the state an existing fish had when history
began (its earlier revisions are unknown). History outlives a deleted
fish.
Links by fish, by dish (including dish-level rows), or open at an instant.

post.description:
Record that an arena recording used a dish (and fish), at Start.

Idempotent on ``recording_ref``: an identical replay is 200, a
different body 409. An existing ref is answered before any dish or
fish check. No server-filled fields in the request. An optional
``X-Delivered-By`` header (e.g. ``citrus``, ``palette``) is recorded on
first creation as ``delivered_by`` and isn't compared on replays.
